title: 2024 Research on LLM-Based Logical Reasoning in Knowledge Graphs
summary: This community centers on a specific 2024 research paper titled 'Complex Logical Reasoning over Knowledge Graphs using Large Language Models.' The work is authored by Nurendra Choudhary and Chandan K. Reddy, focusing on the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform logical reasoning tasks within Knowledge Graph (KG) structures. The paper is identified by the arXiv identifier 2305.01157 and falls under the Computer Science Logic (cs.LO) category.
